lines.speaker: anis

lines.text: It's our duty as police officers to protect citizens like you.
The members of the A.C.P.U. enter the gingerbread house with admirable steadfastness.

Poli carefully places her hand on the wall,
which starts to give way and move backwards.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: This isn't a wall at all. It's a doorway.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I can still see the candy trail.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: This is the right way. No doubt about it.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: The candy trail stopped right in front of the door.

lines.text: Miranda, keep an eye on our six.

lines.text: Congratulations for making it this far.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Should we place her under arrest?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Before that, I'd like to ask some questions.
Before them stands a woman wearing a winsome cooking apron.
Surrounding her are a variety of candies and cakes.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Don't even think about lying. It won't work.

lines.speaker: dressupwoman
lines.text: You're the one I saw before!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: You gave me a certain type of candy.

lines.speaker: dressupwoman
lines.text: I didn't realize you were the actual police!

lines.speaker: dressupwoman
lines.text: a kid wearing a costume for Halloween.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: She could just be trying to mess with our heads.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: What's the big idea with giving me that candy?

lines.text: This has to be some kind of misunderstanding.

lines.text: I don't have the confectionary skills to

lines.text: Novel said that if we ate it, we'd lose our sense of taste.

lines.speaker: dressupwoman
lines.text: You see? A colossal misunderstanding, and nothing more.

lines.speaker: dressupwoman
lines.text: I made some candies that apparently didn't turn out so well, that's all.

lines.text: Then what is this hidden area?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Why did you drop candies on the ground and lure us over here?

lines.text: The staff is the last thing you should be worrying about. Like I told you, we're police.

lines.text: I'll clean up everything and leave straight away!

lines.text: that candy just tasted terrible? That's it?

lines.speaker: dressupwoman
lines.text: I highly doubt it's so bad that anyone lost their sense of taste.

lines.text: So please, can you find it in yourselves to forgive me?

lines.text: but how come you're making such repugnant candy in the first place?

lines.text: I just like cooking for fun.

lines.text: It might not have been the case of the century, but thanks to you, we managed to wrap it up quickly.

the Halloween event narrowly averted a major hiccup,
and instead passed peacefully and without issue.
